final: WITH overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(amount) as overall_avg FROM budget WHERE amount IS NOT NULL), event_avgs AS (SELECT link_to_event, AVG(amount) as event_avg FROM budget WHERE amount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_event), above_avg AS (SELECT event_avg FROM event_avgs WHERE event_avg > (SELECT overall_avg FROM overall_avg)), above_avg_mean AS (SELECT AVG(event_avg) as mean_val FROM above_avg) SELECT ea.link_to_event, ea.event_avg, ea.event_avg - (SELECT overall_avg FROM overall_avg) as beats_overall, ea.event_avg - (SELECT mean_val FROM above_avg_mean) as gap_from_above_mean FROM event_avgs ea WHERE ea.event_avg > (SELECT overall_avg FROM overall_avg) ORDER BY (ea.event_avg - (SELECT mean_val FROM above_avg_mean)) DESC LIMIT 10
